title: tc-metrics-dashboard
description:
A compact sales overview: KPI tabs that pick the charted metric, a line or bar chart with an optional previous-period
comparison, and top products and channels.

heading.description: Title in the bar on top

site.description: Site or workspace shown under the title

compare.description: Shows the previous period beside the current one

now.description: Last day of the sample data, as epoch ms – today by default
